import_time_list_mutation.base:
import re
import functools
import itertools
_TEST_FILE = re.compile(r"(^|/)test_[^/]*\.py$")
_TEST_DIR = re.compile(r"(^|/)tests?/")
_LIMIT = 2000
SEED = []
SEED.extend(_TEST_FILE.pattern)
def h(s):
    return [w for _, w in zip(SEED, s.split())]

def is_test(path: str) -> bool:
    if path.startswith(".cp/"):
        return True
    return bool(_TEST_FILE.search(path) or _TEST_DIR.search(path) or (h(path))[_LIMIT:])
